images.caption: Figure 1:A minimal pair from DominoBench-1K, also in DominoBench-124. Left: the still of item (a). A pushed stone ball sets off two rows of dominoes, and a small ball drops into the bucket of a spiked seesaw above C. Item (b) differs only in a counterweight one grid step (0.25 squares) wider. Zooms: in (a) the ball outweighs the counterweight and the spikes hit C; in (b) the seesaw does not tip. Right: the question and hints, with the H3 value for (b) in parentheses. Each rung is a fresh query with all hints up to it. Unaided, Claude Opus 5.5 gets both items wrong, swapping C’s fates; with H3, it gets both right. Data: pair 4 (items 0004-a and 0004-b).
